diagrams.title: **Two protocols, two layers
diagrams.caption: **Two protocols, two layers.** Built in this section with FastMCP and the MCP client on one side, and Strands `A2AServer` plus the A2A SDK on the other.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 560" aria-label="The whole section on one page. Left, MCP: connects an LLM app to tools and data. Host, client, server. Transports: stdio, Streamable HTTP, custom. Lifecycle: initialize, operate, shut down. Server features: tools, resources, prompt templates. Client features: sampling, roots, elicitation. Built with FastMCP. Right, A2A: connects agents to agents. Agent card for discovery. Message, task and artifact. Bindings: JSON-RPC, gRPC, HTTP plus JSON. Styles: synchronous, asynchronous polling, streaming, push notifications. Built with Strands A2AServer and the A2A SDK.
